description: Given a free-text description of a task (e.g. 'write a cold email to a client'), finds the best-matching existing prompt(s) from GateOnAI's prompt library using real BM25 full-text search - not a semantic guess or an invented relevance score. Each result includes the actual prompt text, which tool it's designed for, and the profession it comes from.

limit.description: Number of matching prompts to return (1-10, default 5)

task.description: Free-text description of the task, e.g. 'write a cold email to a client' or 'summarize a legal contract'

name: match_prompt_to_task

is_error.description: True if the tool could not complete the request

links.description: gateonai.com URLs referenced in the result, in order of appearance

markdown.description: The full result as Markdown (same as the text content), including GateOnAI's disclaimer

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced this result

title: Match a Prompt to My Task
